text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru prepares to face the 
Kinko Sho. However, Silence Suzuka is also 
entered in today's race...

Machikane Fukukitaru overflowed with 
confidence, knowing she was not the same 
person she was last year.

Silence Suzuka is worried by her strange 
demeanor, but she is blinded by the idea 
that relying on luck is enough to win.

With a look in her eyes more dangerous 
than usual, she headed out toward the 
race.
